description: This file defines interfaces and function declarations for the CCSP Message Bus Interface Service, used for initializing, finalizing, and handling message bus communication in an embedded Linux environment. It includes function prototypes for message bus engagement, resource management, signal broadcasting, and DBus message handling.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface and registers the Dbus path with specified configuration.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Implements the interface used by PNM for initialization with user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Implements the interface used by PNM for cleanup with user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status or health of the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources with specified priority and user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating a parameter value has changed.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_SendTransferCompleteSignal
methods.description: Signals that a transfer has been completed.

methods.name: CcspPandM_path_message_func
methods.description: A callback function to handle incoming DBus messages received on the registered path.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers the component to configuration registry or control repository with given parameters.
